test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following questions a statement has been given with highlighted text. Select the options that can replace the text with correct idiom or phrase.

The judge was __extremely angry__ at the attitude of the culprit.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given idiom is **"make one's blood boil"**. (किसी का खून खौला देना)
 
• This idiom is used to describe extreme anger or agitation caused by someone or something.
 
 
• **Example**: *The way he treated her made her blood boil.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, it implies that the judge was very angry because of the culprit's attitude.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **"make one's blood boil"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Play by the ear**: This idiom means to handle a situation as it develops without having a definite plan in advance. (अनुसार चलना)
 
• **Throw caution to the wind**: This idiom means to disregard caution or carefulness and to take a risk without worrying about the consequences. (सावधानी ना बारतना)
 
• **Back to the drawing board**: This idiom is used when a plan or idea has failed and it's necessary to start over from the beginning. (फिर से शुरुआत करना)

10b:T9da,

The correct answer is** 'Option 1'**
